title: Hardlight Joints

markdown: You replace the joints and other mobility-requisite parts of heavier armor (medium and heavy armor) with silent hardlight projectors. If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, a version modded in this way does not.
